headline: Weathered Expanse Again Leads Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, WeatheredExpanseHex remains the chief arena of base reversals, recording thirty-nine events in twenty-four hours, fifteen in six hours and two in the latest two; its ledger now shows five Colonial, two Warden and two neutral bases. MooringCountyHex has edged up to thirty-five daily events, with three in six hours, though none in the latest two; the Wardens retain eleven bases to one Colonial. PalantineBermHex has quickened to eleven events, including three in the latest two hours, amid sharply rising casualty and enlistment rates, and now stands at six Warden bases to one Colonial. StlicanShelfHex holds fourteen daily events and three in six hours, with four Warden and five Colonial bases, while its casualty rates have cooled. NevishLineHex has three daily events and heavy, accelerating activity, with seven Warden bases to one Colonial. StonecradleHex records four daily events, but no event in the latest six hours; eight Colonial bases and one Warden remain. LinnMercyHex also shows accelerating casualties and enlistments beside three daily base events. Most other regions report no recent ownership movement.
